To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Mississippi Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All available contracting and procurement documents and communications, including requests for proposals (RFPs) and/or requests for quotes (RFQs); all bids and proposals; all executed contracts with amendments, extensions, and supportive materials (active and expired); and any related agreements between Mississippi Department of Corrections and/or Mississippi State Government and private healthcare contracting corporations that were active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025. This includes any documents related to contracts from before 2001, but active during the period of interest.        

To assist in your search, below is a partial list of documents that we believe should be included in this request:      
- RFP#3120002800

If healthcare operations for incarcerated individuals in Mississippi State Prisons were contracted to entities other than private healthcare contracting corporations (ex. Universities), we request the same available documents active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Elizabeth Evans-Ralston

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Maine Freedom of Access Act, I hereby request the following records:

All available contracting and procurement documents and communications, including requests for proposals (RFPs) and/or requests for quotes (RFQs); all bids and proposals; all executed contracts with amendments, extensions, and supportive materials (active and expired); and any related agreements between Maine Department of Corrections and/or Maine State Government and private healthcare contracting corporations that were active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025. This includes any documents related to contracts from before 2001, but active during the period of interest.       

To assist in your search, below is a partial list of documents that we believe should be included in this request:     
-  RFP #202009141
- ADVANTAGE CONTRACT #: 03A 20210824*0464
- ADVANTAGE CONTRACT #: 03A 20200805-0388
- CT 03A 20120620-6072
- CT 03A-20070716*01791

If healthcare operations for incarcerated individuals in Maine State Prisons were contracted to entities other than private healthcare contracting corporations (ex. Universities), we request the same available documents during active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025.

I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as we believe this request is in the public interest, as suggested but not stipulated by 1 M.R.S.A. § 408(6). The requested documents will be made available to the general public free of charge as part of the public information service at MuckRock.com, and is not made for commercial usage.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Elizabeth Evans-Ralston
